_variant_note: Wave-4 filter-trap: customer asks 'what's the status of my cheque book request'. The customer names the cheque book request (REQ-CB-94851). But there's ALSO a charges dispute request (REQ-DIS-94852) that was resolved with a refund — the customer might not know about this resolution. A get_all_requests query filtered by category=cheque_book hides the resolved dispute. Broad query reveals both requests — and the resolved dispute with the Rs 500 refund the customer should know about.

get_all_requests._comment: FILTER TRAP: customer asks about cheque book request (REQ-CB-94851) and supplies the request_id. A category=cheque_book filter hides the resolved dispute. Broad query (or also calling get_all_requests) reveals both requests. The model should query all requests AND check the specific request status.
